methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.

original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. Check current handoffs, including #5625 row reentry and #5707 root-prefix lowering, without treating their partial scope as the whole theorem. Prove or falsify that implication with a caller-bound argument; stop at the chosen obligation. Finite tests or root digits do not discharge an all-size statement.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.

actual_scope: The selected #6030 primary recorder stores only width-1 lower_child recipes. It has no joint multiplicity-f phase. On the first rank-1 MOVE, event 9896 from frame 3 to frame 7, the stored phase integer is p=1. Copying that integer as one joint phase disagrees with U tensor U at every one of the 512 by 512 input pairs, while i^{2p} agrees.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one assumption ID and one quantified implication at the actual caller. The assumption is native_all_columns. This implication is the primary recorder's phase integer, left open by the merged MOVE phase law. It is not a discharge of the assumption and not the scalar SCALE/ADD/COPY lift.
bottleneck_link: Side result; no new kappa. A joint certificate that copies the width-1 phase integer mis-signs this MOVE at width 2. The primary itself never builds that joint recipe. The other four assumptions and the selected exponent stay in place.
stop_rule: Stop after the source inspection of the primary native function and the exhaustive width-2 comparison of this one rank-1 MOVE. Do not rerun the full native replay or census every chart pair.
evidence: verify.py prints PASS_PRIMARY_MOVE_PHASE_INTEGER with event=9896, phase=1, bases=512 and pairs=262144.
